_comment: agent-wallet (github.com/DaveForan/agent-wallet), its daemon over streamable HTTP. The cap is a mandate's lifetime cap, set by the operator through the control API, so it is out-of-band: reset-daemon.sh grants mandate 'probe' a cap of 100 cents on a fresh database before every reading. Amounts are integer cents as strings, which is what the probe sends at a cap of 100 (150 and 30). There is no agent-callable read-back of spend against a mandate, so the counter cross-check does not run. request_payment has no idempotency parameter, so the mapping drops the probe's idempotency_key and the report lists the retry shape as not supported, without sending it.
name: agent-wallet daemon, Stripe test mode, mandate cap 100 cents
